A true corner of Italy and Italian cuisine in Ho chi min.
Jan 2026 • Friends
Are you in Vietnam in Ho Chi Min? Nothing to take away from the local cuisine that is always a good experience, but if like us, after 15 days you want to feel in ITALY, this restaurant is the right choice. Carmine, the owner, makes the real difference between those who write Italian cuisine and those who, like him, originally from Avellino, take care of the original products that comes from our country, the training of pizza makers and cooks and the typical warmth of our Italian. For three nights we had dinner here, everything great, delicious, fresh and the flavors are really ours. Carmine is an exceptional person, of extraordinary culture and international experience and welcomed us as if we had known each other for many years. Italians in Ho Chi Min? I'll write it in capitals WENT TO TERRAVIVA TO SEE CARMINE!
